title: Armored Rogue in Three Poses
description: Three separate views of a young male warrior in dynamic action poses against a dark studio backdrop. He wears detailed fantasy armor with copper and gold pauldrons, a leather harness, tattered dark fabric, and feathered mechanical wings, while wielding two daggers in combat stances.
prompt: A young athletic male rogue with styled brown hair, wearing intricate copper and gold fantasy armor with leather straps, tattered dark grey fabric skirt, knee pads, and mechanical feathered wings on his back. He is shown in three different dynamic combat poses holding two sharp daggers, one raised overhead and one in a low stance, against a solid dark studio background with dramatic lighting.
